title: What about the basement?
content: Has anyone else been in the lower levels or have gotten trapped with impossibly small openings for escape? For example, there’s a library at mine, and there’s a ramp up to it, with a gap between it and the building. I’ve fallen through and into a basement level that’s darker, lots of iron structures, and small. The only way to escape is through a just-too-small window opening back into the mall. I look around and the iron walls keep changing their sizes/compression/extension everytime I look behind me, specifically. The other side of the window opening is usually BRIGHT, and people walk by like there is nothing on the other side.
